subject: Re: Order Form & MSA redlines — auto-renew, notice window, termination for convenience
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novafin.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novafin.com
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NovaFin proposed redlines (MSA + Order Form)

Marcus — attaching our redlines to the MSA and the Order Form. Primary items: auto-renew with 60-day notice (we prefer opt-in rather than opt-out), a limited termination-for-convenience right for pilot accounts with a 90-day notice, and a request for a one-time migration assistance credit if we exit within the first 12 months.

Key asks (summary):
- Change auto-renew to explicit opt-in at renewal (we currently propose no auto-renew) or, if Redwood requires auto-renew, increase notice window to 60 days and include a simple opt-out flow.
- Add a 90-day termination-for-convenience provision for pilot and POC order forms with pro-rated refund mechanics.
- Migration assistance: $25k credit or equivalent technical assistance if we terminate within 12 months.
- Request SOC 2 evidence and a short data retention statement in the Order Form.

Attached: NovaFin_MSA_redlines_20251127.docx, OrderForm_v3.pdf

Samira Khan
Senior Counsel, NovaFin
samira.khan@novafin.com
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novafin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NovaFin proposed redlines (MSA + Order Form)

Samira — thanks for the redlines and clear summary. I reviewed with Product and Legal — high level responses below, and I copied Karthik (sales) and Monica (CS) for implementation implications.

Short answers:
- Auto-renew: Redwood's standard is a 30-day opt-out notice for production subscriptions. For pilots/POCs we can offer a different path. We're open to a customer-friendly playbook: remove automatic renewal for pilot order forms (explicit end date) OR keep auto-renew for production but increase notice to 60 days for NovaFin. Which do you prefer?
- Termination for convenience (pilot): We can accept a 90-day termination window for pilot Order Forms with pro-rated credits, provided the MSA limits rewrite exposure (no refund of seat-based usage beyond pro-rated prepaid amounts).
- Migration assistance: we can offer a migration credit structure (technical hours + $15k credit). The full $25k credit is above standard pilot concession — happy to discuss as part of commercial trade-offs.
- SOC 2 + data retention: will share SOC 2 summary and a short data-retention clause in the Order Form (Monica, can you confirm retention language and evidence location?).

Proposed next step: If NovaFin confirms whether they want (A) no auto-renew for pilots, or (B) keep auto-renew with 60-day notice, we'll prepare a clean Order Form with the agreed pilot carve-outs and track as a canary change to the main MSA.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

> > Marcus — attaching our redlines to the MSA and the Order Form....
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novafin.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NovaFin proposed redlines (MSA + Order Form)

Samira — appreciate the clarity. A couple of commercial points from my side so we can align legal and procurement negotiation: 
- If NovaFin needs the full $25k migration credit, we should balance that with a 12-month committed minimum spend on Redwood Dedicated or guaranteed minimum monthly usage on Hosted API (we can structure a scaled credit if minimums are met).
- If we agree to remove auto-renew for pilots (option A), we usually add a short renewal outreach cadence so we don't lose the relationship on the back of an expired trial (e.g., 45 day and 15 day outreach).

Suggested trade: Migration assistance credit to be set at $20k up-front with an additional $5k credit applied if NovaFin commits to a 12-month minimum or reaches a $150k ARR threshold within 12 months. Alternatively, keep $15k credit no strings and include a 90-day termination-for-convenience for the pilot but remove any prepaid seat refunds beyond prorated amounts.

Let us know which commercial path you prefer — we can reflect in a revised order form.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novafin.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novafin.com, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 16:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NovaFin proposed redlines (MSA + Order Form)

Thanks Marcus / Karthik — aligned internally and we can do the following: 

- Pilot Order Form: no auto-renew; fixed term ending 90 days after execution unless both parties sign an extension. We accept pro-rated refunds for any prepaid fees (limited to unused committed seats).
- Migration assistance: NovaFin accepts Redwood's revised structure: $20k credit up-front, and an additional $5k credit contingent on reaching the $150k ARR threshold within 12 months.
- For production order forms after pilot, NovaFin will accept a 60-day opt-out notice rather than removing auto-renew entirely.
- Please add a short data-retention paragraph and attach SOC 2 summary.

Request: Can you send a clean Order Form and a redlined MSA that reflect the above (we prefer a single tracked redline doc for final legal review) and a DocuSign link for signature?

Attachments requested: clean_OrderForm_v4.pdf (for signature), tracked_MSA_NF_redline.docx

Samira Khan
Senior Counsel, NovaFin
samira.khan@novafin.com
